text:
sofia: ran a quick llm.int8 (bitsandbytes weight-only) pass on mixtral-7b-ckpt for the deployment bakeoff. posting raw notes + a small eval snapshot.

sofia: TL;DR — latency down ~30%, GPU memory ~48% lower, but small quality regressions on some evals (details below).

sofia: command used:
```
python run_eval.py --model mixtral-7b-ckpt --quant llm.int8 --batch 1 --seq 2048 --metrics mmlu,qa,perplexity
```

sofia: results (local dev cluster, A100-80G):
- latency p50 (seq 512): fp16 120ms -> int8 84ms
- GPU mem: fp16 26GB -> int8 13.5GB
- MMLU overall: fp16 58.3% -> int8 57.4% (delta -0.9%)
- QA F1 (closed-book eval): 71.2 -> 70.8 (delta -0.4%)
- Wikitext perplexity: 9.8 -> 9.98 (small increase)

tyler: those deltas are small but worth tracking. did you use NF4 or default bnb quant? any per-layer mix?

sofia: used default llm.int8 path (weight-only NF4-like packing). no per-layer fine-tune.

tyler: can you repro with `--use-8bit-refine` (if available) or try per-layer fallback for sensitive blocks? sometimes first ~2 layers are critical.

jamie: also try enabling `--quant-topk=128` and run a 5k token sample to see long-context drift. we had a case where short-form accuracy looked fine but long-form coherence dropped.

sofia: good call. i'll run both.

quant-bot: automated-eval summary (artifact: s3://redwood-evals/mixtral/int8/1760301123):
- MMLU delta: -0.9%
- BoolQ acc: -0.3%
- PIQA: +0.1%
- Avg latency improvement: 29%
- GPU mem savings: 48%
- Quality regression flag: "minor" (threshold 0.5% per-primary-metric triggered)

tyler: minor flag but primary metric delta > 0.5%. does this trigger our runtime fallback policy?

jamie: our current rule: if any primary eval (MMLU/QA) drops >0.5% vs pinned baseline, mark as degrade -> require canary to include fp16 fallback route. we should add a per-model tuning profile for mixtral-7b.

sofia: proposal: ship llm.int8 to Dedicated-inference pool for low-priority traffic with an automatic fallback to fp16 for customer-critical routes. add a rollout guard: if live eval (sampled requests) shows >0.7% drop after 1h, flip to fp16.

tyler: sounds reasonable. also capture token-level diff samples for the eval prompts so SRE/product can triage worst-case examples.

sofia: logged sample diffs to the artifact bucket. link: https://s3.redwood.local/mixtral/int8/1760301123/diffs.html :eyes:

ci-engine: CI artifacts and raw logs: https://ci.redwood/syslogs/1760301123 (includes heap/profile, bnb config dump).

jamie: next actions:
- sofia: run `--use-8bit-refine` + `--quant-topk=128` and post new artifact (expected tonight)
- tyler: draft runtime fallback policy change (A/B + canary thresholds)
- quant-bot: add a per-metric weighted score so multiple small deltas don't falsely pass/flag.

sofia: will run refinements and also try an AWQ/GPTQ baseline to compare (quality vs perf). posting new thread when done. :rocket:

tyler: FYI for rollout notes — if we route int8 only to dedicated pools, remember cost calc: int8 throughput -> more qps per GPU, update per-route cost-estimator.

jamie: +1 on cost-estimator. also add a note to the runbook about when to prefer fp16 (e.g., interactive search/assistant flows with strict QoE). :memo:
